# Appendix VIII: Sensors and actuators

This appendix will list details about the sensors and actuators used in a T8 car.

## General

[Sensors]{.underline} are devices used to gather information.
In a Trionic 8 car a lot of sensors are used to determine what actions to take inside the ECU.
These sensors are all analogue, which means they output a signal that has to be converted to digital numbers for the ECU to be able to understand them.
[Actuators]{.underline} on the other hand are devices that enable the ECU to interact with the processes in the car.
Actuators are driven (or activated) by the Trionic be it directly or indirectly.
